paragraphs: The Junior Consultant, Data Science & Marketing Effectiveness role in London will see you applying econometrics and AI to business problems. Ekimetrics is a leader in Marketing Effectiveness, Data Science and AI‑powered solutions and, from its London office, engages across four business offerings – MMM (mixed market modelling), customer analytics, data science transformations and AI4 sustainability. You will work on Marketing Mix Modelling and Customer Analytics projects end‑to‑end, gathering and analysing data, building statistical machine‑learning models and delivering presentations for clients across retail, consumer goods, luxury fashion, insurance and many other industries.

I have built predictive models with scikit‑learn, TensorFlow and Keras, serving them via FastAPI and packaging the environment in Docker containers. In a separate project I designed and maintained metadata pipelines that integrated fourteen source datasets, supporting feature engineering and model development. Both experiences required me to construct end‑to‑end modelling workflows that align with the econometrics and advanced analytics expectations of the role, demonstrating my ability to deliver high‑quality modelling solutions for Marketing Effectiveness challenges.

I have communicated technical solutions to diverse stakeholders using an agentic approach, combining Python and PostgreSQL to create transparent data pipelines that stakeholders could query directly, with continuous integration ensuring reliable delivery. I also implemented SSL encryption and AWS Cognito authentication for a FinTech application, explaining security protocols clearly to non‑technical clients. These experiences show my capacity to convey analytical insights and technical details effectively, meeting the communication standards required for this consultancy role.
